name: d4_evaluation
description: D4 supplementary analyses of frozen and D3/D4 decision rules on held-out test participants S13-S15. No training, no selection on test.

bootstrap.method: moving-block bootstrap within each test participant (participant sizes kept), paired across policies
bootstrap.caveat: Intervals describe variation within these three participants' recordings, not the wider population; consecutive windows overlap by 6 s, so blocks of 30 windows (about 68 s of signal) preserve short-range dependence.

categories.investigation_changed_decision: agent used >= 1 check and its final decision differs from the probability-only rule (p >= 0.5)

failure_cases.representative_example: window closest to the category median of standardized (p, motion intensity, absolute error); chosen by rule, not by hand
